fixed.summary: world.instantiate works inside a system. The root is spawned as world.spawn spawns one there (og.Transform, and og.Parent for a parented root, among the system's writes; its id usable at once), and the scene's entities, or the glTF's og.Model and lights, are in the world when the system returns: the systems after it in the same tick, and a save they take, have them. A second instance of the same named scene in one system is refused at the call, as between ticks. It was refused with "world.instantiate inside a system needs og-ecs SystemContext packed-byte access".
